import unicodedata
import re

def slugify(text: str) -> str:
    """
    Turns a title into a URL slug.
    
    - Lowercases everything
    - Turns accented letters into their plain ASCII letters
    - Drops any other non-ASCII characters
    - Replaces every run of characters that are not a-z or 0-9 with a single hyphen
    - Strips hyphens from both ends
    - Returns an empty string if nothing is left
    """
    # Normalize unicode to decomposed form (NFD) to separate base characters from accents
    nfkd_form = unicodedata.normalize('NFKD', text)
    
    # Encode to ASCII bytes, ignoring non-ASCII characters, then decode back to string
    ascii_text = nfkd_form.encode('ascii', 'ignore').decode('ascii')
    
    # Convert to lowercase
    lower_text = ascii_text.lower()
    
    # Replace any run of non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen
    slug = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', lower_text)
    
    # Strip leading and trailing hyphens
    return slug.strip('-')
